unit.title: From Equations to a Tested MLP Training Step
unit.scope: Implement, verify, and document a small two-layer classifier and its training step using Python and NumPy only.
unit.audience: A strong algorithms student building production-minded software-engineering habits
learning_objectives: Translate a mathematical model contract into shape-safe, modular numerical software.
Derive and implement analytic gradients without an automatic-differentiation framework.
Use deterministic tests and finite differences to find implementation defects.
Run a reproducible, bounded experiment and distinguish evidence from unsupported conclusions.
required_deliverables: A small installable or directly runnable Python/NumPy implementation
Deterministic automated tests, including gradient and numerical-stability checks
A machine-readable experiment report and the command that reproduces it
Written responses to the learner-safe comprehension prompts

unit_completion_requires: Every required deliverable is present and attributable to the learner.
The documented clean-environment test command exits successfully.
The implementation and report satisfy the independent examiner rubric.
An authorized validator records a passing unit result; learner prose alone is not completion evidence.
non_compensable_conditions: The implementation uses analytic learner-written gradients rather than an autodiff or deep-learning framework.
Gradient checks cover every trainable tensor and pass on an examiner-selected non-kink input.
The submitted experiment can be reproduced from a recorded configuration and seed.
completion_policy.after_unit_completion: Record completion only for unit_kickoff_01_tested_mlp. Later units require separately validated official-material retrieval or separately identified manager-authored scope.
completion_policy.whole_course_rule: This kickoff cannot establish completion of CMU 11-785 or of the approximately 120-hour catalog course.
